title: Border Patrol
prompt:
**Problem.** Given a string s, count its border lengths: every
1 <= l < |s| with s[0..l) == s[|s|-l..|s|).

**Constraints:** 2 <= |s| <= 2000001.

Checking every length by direct comparison is the classic near-miss.

tests.name: nested borders
tests.hint: Borders abab and ab — the failure chain visits exactly these lengths.

tests.name: all equal
tests.hint: Borders a, aa, aaa: chain of length 3.

tests.name: load: 1000000 chars
tests.hint: The failure chain is O(n) total; direct comparison for every length is O(n^2).

tests.name: load: 1000001 chars, many borders
tests.hint: Same O(n) chain on a second large string.
